description:
Replace a paginated thread's durable history with the prefix before one turn.

This only changes persisted conversation history. It does not revert local file changes unless `restoreFiles` is set and the server supports it (see `thread/revert/preview`).

beforeTurnId.description: Turn excluded from the replacement history, together with every later turn.

restoreFiles.description: Also put back the workspace files the removed turns changed. Only servers that answer `thread/revert/preview` honour it; if a file cannot be restored, nothing is reverted.

title: ThreadRevertParams
